text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Parkman Avenue, between Franklin Avenue and Perth Avenue. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the traffic calming policy needed to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of Parkman Avenue. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Parkman Avenue, between Franklin Avenue and Perth Avenue, is not recommended.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install two speed humps on Parkman Avenue, between Franklin Avenue and Perth Avenue, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-2645, dated August 2017, attached to the report (January 12, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
